items.title: 2.10 Testing and Debugging in Python (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of testing and debugging (PDF 63).

blocks.text: Python programming mein testing aur debugging zaroori practices (aadatein / kaam) hain, ta ke pakka ho jaye ke code theek aur efficiently (achhi tarah, kam waqt mein) chalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Testing aur debugging mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Testing code chala kar maloom karti hai ke kaam karta hai ya nahi; agar kaam na kare to debugging ghalti ki wajah dhoond kar theek karti hai.

items: Testing: kaam karta hai ya nahi; debugging: ghalti dhoond kar theek karna.
